description.value: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies outside Gehenna, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly and revives with all its Hit Points in Gehenna.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has a magic tome. While holding or carrying the tome, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its Banishing Claw action. The tome has AC 17; HP 35; and Immunity to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage. The tome regains all its Hit Points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points or when the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies. If the tome is destroyed, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can create a new one when it finishes a Short or Long Rest.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three [[/item .BuiIWRZ0Bpnx1Lgi]] attacks. It can replace one attack with a [[/item .AsDCZIFjZNgYrxrP]] attack.

activation.condition: A target hit by Banishing Claw (Requires Soul Tome)

description.value: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Charisma Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=lj3L51L4aopW4Q7V]]. Failure: The target is trapped in a demiplane inside the Soul Tome. While trapped there, the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, escaping the tome on a success. When the target escapes, it appears in the space it left or, if that space is occupied, the nearest unoccupied space. If the target fails three of these saves while in the demiplane, it becomes bound to the tome and can escape only if the tome is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplAlterSelf0]{Alter Self}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplIdentify00]{Identify}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageHand00]{Mage Hand}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPrestidigi]{Prestidigitation}

1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplContactOth]{Contact Other Plane}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectThou]{Detect Thoughts}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDimensionD]{Dimension Door}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMindBlank0]{Mind Blank}
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCounterspe]{Counterspell} in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
